# buddy_ruleset (Data Source)

Get ruleset by identifier or ruleset ID. Only workspace administrators and project managers can read rulesets

Token scope required: `RULESET_READ`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "buddy_ruleset" "by_id" {
  domain       = "mydomain"
  project_name = "myproject"
  ruleset_id   = "4GP6nQPa"
}

data "buddy_ruleset" "by_identifier" {
  domain       = "mydomain"
  project_name = "myproject"
  identifier   = "protect-main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle
- `project_name` (String) The project's name

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) The ruleset's identifier (letter case does not matter)
- `ruleset_id` (String) The ruleset's ID

### Read-Only

- `agent_note` (String) The ruleset's note for agents, null when not set
- `block_force_push` (Boolean) Rewriting the history of a protected branch is not allowed
- `bypass_admins` (Boolean) `true` - workspace administrators and project managers bypass the ruleset, `false` - they do not, null - no entry for them
- `bypass_group` (Attributes Set) Groups that may or may not bypass the ruleset (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bypass_group))
- `bypass_others` (String) Whether the remaining members with access to the project bypass the ruleset (`ALLOWED`, `DENIED`), null - no entry for them
- `bypass_user` (Attributes Set) Users (agents included) who may or may not bypass the ruleset (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bypass_user))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the ruleset is turned off
- `html_url` (String) The ruleset's URL
- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item
- `missing_sources` (Attributes Set) Required checks whose source no longer exists or no longer marks commits with its status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--missing_sources))
- `name` (String) The ruleset's name, null when not set
- `note` (String) The ruleset's note, null when not set
- `refs` (Set of String) Patterns of the refs the ruleset protects
- `require_pull_request` (Boolean) Changes reach a protected branch only by merging a pull request
- `require_up_to_date` (Boolean) The pull request branch must also contain the current state of the target branch
- `required_pipelines` (Set of String) Identifiers of the pipelines that must succeed, null when none
- `required_unit_tests_suites` (Set of String) Identifiers of the unit tests suites that must pass, null when none
- `required_visual_tests_suites` (Set of String) Identifiers of the visual tests suites that must be approved, null when none
- `restrict_creation` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may create a protected ref
- `restrict_deletion` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may delete a protected ref
- `restrict_update` (Boolean) Only users who bypass the ruleset may move a protected ref
